content: Saulo, Bab-Jesús-abingasad
Saulo Jesúsʼba-nanaimalad-isdar-dakedbali, emar-ogilogedginbi binsadiid. A-ulale, Saulo garda-amiega, dule-irwa-Babse-goled-bur-dummadse nadegusad.
Adi, nabir Damascoʼgi Judíoʼmar-onmakedneg-bukmaladse dogegar. A-gardade Sauloʼga igar-uknaid, adi, nabir machergan, omegan Jesúsʼba-nanaimalad gaegar. Amar gugmakar Jerusalénʼse sedagegar.
Saulo igarba-nadapgu, Damasco-neggwebur-omodanigu, ukiar nibneggi gwallu mee egi ganonikid.
Agi, napase aimukud gusad. Geb nibneggi dule ega soge itoalid: —Saulo, Saulo, ¿ibiga be an-baregindii?
Saulo abin-sogded: —Dummad, ¿be doasunna? Dule, abin-imakded: —Ani an Jesús, ar ani be an-balegindiid, ani an a-duled. [Ikogi be didii annaye sogele, na be dukin nunmaked amioed.]
Saulo nue-dobed-abalagine, wawanmakale, sogded: —Dummad, ¿ibi imakbi be an-abesunna? Dummad, abin-imakde, ega sogded: —Be gwisgu, neggweburse be nae, agi bega sogmaloed, ibu be imakoe.
Dule-Sauloʼba-nadapgusmalad bela-bela dobe itodmalad, geg sunmake gudmalad. Ar ade, gayaburba gole itosmalad, degi-inigwele, gwen dule daksurmalad.
Saulo napagi-mai gwisgudgu, aku-dulemar-dake gwisgualid, e-ibya bela sobmor gusad. Degisoggu, e-sordamar argangi-annikaa Damascoʼse Saulo-searmarsunnad.
Saulo, ibapaa Damasco-neggweburgi aku-atake megisad. Mas guchasulid, gobsasurbalid.

Deun, Damasco-neggweburgi Bab-Jesúsʼba-naid-wargwen maigusad. A-dulede, Ananíasʼye-nugad. A-dulega Bab-Jesús gabgi ibmar sognonikid. Weyob sognonikid: —¡Ananías! Geb Ananías abin-sogded: —Naa, Dummad, wegi an mai, an be-itomai.
Agi Bab-Jesús ega sogded: —Gwisgu, Judas-negse be nae, Igar-Innikigwadye-nugadba be nao. Be modapile, Tarso-dule-Sauloʼye-nugadi be egisdapoed. A-dulede, a-neggi Bab-Dummadse gormaid.
Ar Saulo bato gabgi dule-wargwen-Ananíasʼye-nugad daksad. Ese dogdani, degi, egi argan-mesnai daksad, adi, nabir gannar atakegar.
Ananías, Bab-Jesús ega degi-soge itosgu, sogded: —Dummad, dule-bukidar we-dulegi sunmakmar an-itodiid, igi Jerusalénʼgi beba-nanaimalad beedse wiosa.
Deginbali, wegi Damascoʼgi dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-e-dummagan ega igar-uksamogad, adi, nabir beba-nanaimalad bela gaegar, esgaryagi metegar.
Bab-Jesús, abin-imakded: —Be nae, ar we-dule an-sapinga-guega an susmogad. Adi, nabir Judíoʼsurmaladga, reymarga, degi, amba Israel-dulemarga, an-nuggi sunmakegar.
Degisoggu, ani an Sauloʼga oyogoed, an-sapinga-guedi, beedse an-nug-ular wilegergebye.

Deyob Bab-Jesús ega sogsagu, Ananías Judas-negse nadsunnad. Modapgu, Ananías, e-argan Sauloʼgi-mesisgu, ega sogded: —Gwenad-Saulo, Dummad-Jesús igarba-danigu bese-magarosad-dule, a an-barmialid. Adi, nabir gannar be atakbaligar, degi, Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaled bela-bela be nikubaligar.
Degi-ega-sogsagu, Saulo-ibyagi ua-ukayobi-naidi, yog babatiargusad. Geb degi, nabir gannar ataknaded. Geb Saulo a-sorba, yog Bab-diigi-ogleged-igargi oglessunnad.
Saulo geb mas guchagu, wis gannaledsunnad. Agi, Damascoʼgi dulemar-Jesúsʼba-nanaimalad-walik ibbigbasaar gudigusad.
Saulo Damascoʼgi Bab-Jesús-igargi sunmaksad
Geb agi Saulo, Jesucristo-igargi yog sunmakar imakded. Judíoʼmar-onmakedneg-irba, sogdii gusad, Jesús Bab-Dummad-Machi-sunnadye.

Saulo-itoarmalale, bela geger itoddamalad. Sogdedamalad: “¿We-dulede, Jerusalénʼgine dulemar-Jesúsʼba-nanaimalad-baregindii dasursi? ¿Ar amba we-dulede dulemar-Jesúsʼba-nanaimalad-gaega wese nonisursi? Adi, Jerusalénʼse sedega, dule-irwa-Babse-gormalad-e-dummaganga ukegar.”

Ar Saulo aka bur bule Bab-Jesús-igargi-sunmaked gangumai gusad. Jesús we, Cristo-sunnadye, Bab-Dummad-dule-wargwen-barmidagoye-sogsad-duleye sogdii gusad. Degisoggu, Damascoʼgi Judíoʼmar-bukwadi geg Pablo-abin-imake gusmalad.
Saulo Judíoʼmar-Damascoʼgi-bukmaladgi wakichad
A-ibagan-nasad-sorba, Judíoʼmar Saulo-oburgwemalaga igar amismalad.
Saulo dulemar-e-oburgwebimalad wisgusad. Saulo-oburgwemalagala, Judíoʼmar bane-bane neggwebur-yawagak-nagaba, mutikidba, ibginse-bakar, Saulo-edarbebukwa gusmalad.
Jesúsʼba-nanaimaladdi, Saulo-nabir-wakinnega, mutikidba neggwebur-galu-dikarba garbagi Saulo-odesmarsunnad.
Saulo Jerusalénʼse modapgusad
Saulo Jerusalén-mosgu, Jesúsʼba-nanaimaladba ambikubi gualinad. Ar Jesúsʼba-nanaimaladdi dobe itomalad, ar ade, Bab-Jesúsʼba-naimodeeye gwen Sauloʼgi binsasurmalad.

Degi-inigwele, Bernabéʼdi Jesús-e-sapingan-bur-dummagan-bukwadse Saulo-sesagusad. Amarga sogdesunnad, igi Saulo Damasco-igarba-nadapgu, Bab-Jesús-daksagusa. Agine, igi Jesús ega sogsagusbali, deginbali, igi Saulo Damascoʼgi dobsuli, nue-gandikidba Jesús-nuggine sunmaksagusbali.
Agi, Saulo Jerusalénʼgi bessunnad, degi, Jesús-e-sapingan-bur-dummaganba bipirmakdii guarsunnad.
Deun, Saulo, dobsuli Bab-Jesús-nuggi sunmakdii gualid. Judíoʼmar-Griego-gaya-sunmakmalad-ebo dobsuli na abin-abin imakdii gualid. Amardi, Saulo-oburgwebi-gusmalanad, degite, gwen oburgwissurmalad.
Gwenadgan-Jesúsʼba-nanaimalad degi-wisguarmargu, Cesarea-neggweburse Saulo-sesmalad, geb Tarso-neggweburse Saulo-barmismarsunnad.

Degisoggu, Jesúsʼba-nanaimalad-danar-ambikunonidamalad bela Judea-yalagi, Galileaʼgi, degi, Samariaʼgi, nue-bogidiki, dule-e-bareginnedsuli bukwa gusmarsunnad. A-ulale, Jesúsʼba-nanaimalad burbar nue-gangumai, Bab-Jesús-dobee-nanabukwa gusmalad. Degine, Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaled amar-ogannomai-gussunnad, ega Jesúsʼba-nanaimalad-omelomai gussunnad.
Pedro Eneas-nudaksad
Pedro bela gwenadgan-bukmaladse atakdigua, Lida-neggweburgi gwenadgan-Jesucristoʼgi-akananaimaladse ataknad gusmogad.
A-neggweburgi Pedro dule-wargwen Eneasʼye-nugad birgabaabakgus (8) abagan-burgwaled-nika-mai dakdapid.
Pedro Eneasʼga sogdesun: —Eneas, Jesucristo be-nudakoed. Be gwisgu, be-meged be nudake, be nae. Agi Eneas nugusgu, yog gwisguar imaksad.
Pedro, Eneas-onudaksad-sorba belagwapa Lida-neggweburgi-bukwamalad, Sarón-nebagi-bukwamalad Eneas-nugusad daksamalad. A-ulale, amar Bab-Jesúsʼba nue nagusmarmogad.
Pedro gannar Dorcas-odulosad

A-ibagangi, Jope-neggweburgi ome-wargwen Bab-Jesúsʼba-nue-nai gusmogad. A-omede, Tabitaʼye-nugad, Griego-gayabardi, Dorcasʼye bileged. A-omede, igar-nueganbi imakdiid, degi, wilegana-nue-bendakdidaed.
A-ibagangi, Dorcasʼde uellealid, geb burgwisad. Burgwisgu, nue ogsamalad. A-sorba, neg-aila-niba mesismalad.

Jope-neggwebur Lida-neggweburgi itakasaar siid. Geb Jesúsʼba-nanaimalad wisguargu, Pedro Lida-neggweburgi gudiiye, dule-warbo Pedroʼse barmisgusmalad, Pedro-sunamalagar. Amar Pedroʼga sogdapmalad: “Gwae Jopeʼse be dagoye, mer be yoggudoye.”

Pedro dulemar-warbogwadba Jopeʼse arsunnad. Jopeʼse-nonimargu, neg-aila-niba Dorcas-mui-maidse Pedro-sesmalad. Omegan-ei-sui-burgwismalad ise-boale Pedro-ebilis ambikunonimalad. Geb omegan, Dorcas-subamar-ega-maksad, degi, mormar-ega-maksad, Pedroʼga oyonanaiguarmalad.

A-sorba, Pedro bela dulemar-bukwad onisad. Geb Pedro yokorgi sindigar-sigisgu, Bab-Dummadse goted. Pedro, Dorcas-muisik aibiridgu, ega sogded: “Tabita, gwisgu.” Geb degi, Dorcas ibya argaalid, Pedro-dakargu, sigisa imaksad.
Pedro, argangi Dorcas-gasaa ogwichisa imaksad. Geb Pedro a-sorba, Jesucristoʼba-nanaimaladse, omegan-ei-sui-burgwismaladse, dula Dorcas-senonikid.
Weyob-gusadi, bela Jope-neggweburgi wisgusmalad. Bukidar a-neggweburginmalad Bab-Jesúsʼgi bensur-gunonimalad.
Agi, Pedro undar Jopeʼgi megialid. Simónʼye-nugad-neggi mai-gusad. Simónʼde ibmar-ukagi-arbaed-duled.
